draft_key_information_units.information: Consolidated net sales decreased 3.4% to €7.33 million in 2025 from €7.59 million in 2024, with EU sales (92% of total) remaining flat and sales to Africa/Asia dropping sharply; real estate management revenue fell to €3 thousand from €25 thousand.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report Overview section (pages 4-5), Note 15 Revenue breakdown (page 50)

draft_key_information_units.information: Consolidated EBITDA was -€0.42 million in 2025 (vs -€0.03 million in 2024) with a margin of -6% (vs 0%), and net loss widened to €1.15 million from €0.79 million; losses were driven by December factory shutdowns (planned for boiler house transition in 2025 vs unplanned weather damage in 2024).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report Overview (page 4), EBITDA by Business Segments table (page 4)

draft_key_information_units.information: Total assets increased to €9.3 million (from €8.3 million in 2024), with current assets at €1.829 million (including inventories of €1.034 million and cash of €5 thousand) and total liabilities at €4.9 million; equity rose to €4.462 million due to a share capital increase.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position (page 23), Note 13 Equity details (page 49)

draft_key_information_units.information: Operating activities generated net cash outflow of €503 thousand (vs €174 thousand outflow in 2024); investing activities used €989 thousand (primarily €1.367 million in production assets and €161 thousand in real estate, partially offset by €539 thousand share sale proceeds); financing activities provided €1.444 million net cash inflow.

Fibreboard production and sales accounted for 100% of revenue (€7.33 million) with EBITDA of -€296 thousand; real estate management contributed minimal revenue (€3 thousand) and EBITDA of -€86 thousand, reflecting terminated rental agreements.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 22 Operating Segments (page 52), Real Estate Management section (page 5)

draft_key_information_units.information: The group merged with subsidiary Pärnu Riverside Development OÜ effective June 1, 2025; the Admirali Quarter development project achieved completed design works and building permits for key areas, with a preliminary sale agreement for ten properties executed on January 8, 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Company Profile (page 3), Real Estate Management (page 5), Note 26 Post-balance-sheet events (page 55)

draft_key_information_units.information: Share capital increased to €850 thousand from €450 thousand through a €2.0 million share premium issuance in October 2025, raising total equity to €4.462 million from €3.616 million.

A planned December 2025 factory shutdown for new gas boiler house transition (vs unplanned 2024 weather damage) and underutilized capacity negatively impacted EBITDA; energy solution upgrades were completed in January 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report Fibreboard Production section (page 4-5), Overview of Operating Results (page 4)

draft_key_information_units.information: After the reporting period, a preliminary sale-purchase agreement was signed on January 8, 2026, for ten Admirali Quarter properties, with finalization conditional on satisfaction of terms by June 30, 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 26 Events after balance sheet date (page 55)

evaluation.selection_rationale: Units D1-D7 capture headline performance, profitability, balance sheet position, cash flows, segment dynamics, and strategic capital actions—core to understanding financial health and business direction. D8 and D9 address material operational drivers and post-period developments affecting future outlook. Excluded routine governance, remuneration, risk lists, and accounting policies per evaluation guidelines. Each unit represents an independently omittable material theme supported exclusively by source document evidence.
